title: Operation Rolling Thunder begins
description: The United States began Operation Rolling Thunder, the sustained bombing campaign against North Vietnam that marked a major escalation of the war during Larry's year there.
researchNotes: The start date is cited to the official USAF history of the campaign. 2026-09-14: the founding brief's memory of stories about aircraft dumping bombs into the ocean (2026-brief-bomb-jettison, paraphrase) was removed from this description. The archive had placed it here; Larry has not tied it to Rolling Thunder or to any date, and the source cited does not address it. It stays on its recollection record and in ledger #6, which asks for documented jettison procedure, aborted missions, political restriction and period rumour to be kept apart.
